tokenize_text_with_regexp: create a python module that uses RegexpTokenizer to tokenize text into tokens with punctuation and contractions
tokenize_text_with_simple: create a python module that uses SimpleTokenizer to tokenize text into alphanumeric tokens and non-whitespace characters
extract_ngrams_from_tokens: create a function that extracts n-grams of length n from a Tokens object with optional filtering
extract_entity_groups: create a function that groups consecutive NER-tagged tokens into entity groups from a Tokens object
untokenize_tokens_to_text: create a function that reconstructs the original text from a Tokens object by reinserting whitespace
